`pattern_fit`: B — the one-line published fix leaves three uncovered routes at the pinned commit (parser differential on the checked host identity, 404/405 paths that never build the middleware stack, CORS preflight answered at app level).
Strongest lever: the how-type identity split — `host.split(":")[0]` is checked while the raw Host becomes the URL netloc (`allowed_hosts.py:67` + `datastructures/url.py:182-201`), which models will read as "not the reported header".
Biggest red flag: none hold by definition, but the published fix is one function/one line with `www_redirect` as the only must-keep-working coupling, so the host is thin unless the O8 routes count.
